evidence.detail: 2290334, on page 10, ran in 2018-01 as a 3-bedroom, 3-bath duplex. 2326827, on page 1 in 2017-11, repeats its ad copy word for word, with the same room sizes: Listing 2326827 text: "spacious living room 19.5 x 22.2" and "Spacious Master Bedroom 19.5 x 13.4".
3448504 (2021-03) and 4764834 (2025-06), both on page 1, repeat the same copy and room sizes for the 3-bedroom, 3-bath garden duplex.

evidence.quote: Truly One of a Kind 3BR duplex in Gramercy Park! First Floor The apartment features a spacious living room 19.5 x 22.2 which also leads out to large private landscaped garden

note: The ground-floor garden duplex, listed once under page 10 and otherwise under page 1. The building's other pages, 3r and 4f, are small walk-up units on upper floors.
